description: This Java class defines ServiceEcaCondition, which represents a condition used in service event condition actions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes logic for evaluating conditions based on service calls or field comparisons, with support for constants, maps, and various comparison types.

classes.name: ServiceEcaCondition
classes.description: Represents a condition for service event actions, capable of evaluating service-based or field-based conditions with support for constants and maps.
